source: Measured from the real stacking recordings of Harrysunshine/so101-smolvla-sim-real-10task. Top camera, joint zero points and table height, fitted together: robot outline and both cubes in 114 top pictures of 38 recordings (start, 25 frames before the gripper closes, release) plus the grasp and release heights of 187 recordings (vla_testing/diagnostics/calibrate_top_camera.py). A joint zero point is what has to be added to a recorded joint number to get the angle of the simulated robot; the wrist roll was not measured. Wrist camera: outline of the two black jaws and the red cube in 152 wrist pictures of 38 recordings, taken 5 to 60 frames before the gripper closes (vla_testing/diagnostics/calibrate_wrist_camera.py). Table picture: per-pixel median of 104 top pictures of episode 33 with robot and cube pixels left out.

arm_drives.source: The recording robot's arm has weight and its motors hold it with a position error; the simulator switches the arm's weight off. With the weight on, these drives make the simulated readings follow the recorded commands as the recorded readings did: fitted on 20 recordings, checked on 20 others (vla_testing/diagnostics/fit_arm_drives.py).
